name: model-router
description: Keeps Claude as the primary reasoning agent while shunting bulk file reading to a cheap worker model. A PreToolUse hook gates large reads, the gate fails open so a broken worker degrades to plain Claude Code, and every delegation is measured. Slash commands expose the diagnostic and the report.

worker_provider.title: Worker provider
worker_provider.description: Which cheap model runs the delegated work. ollama needs no API key and runs locally; gemini needs GEMINI_API_KEY in your environment. Leaving this alone keeps the shipped default, which is gemini.

worker_model.title: Worker model
worker_model.description: The model id to send. It must be one the provider above actually owns: pairing ollama with a gemini model name is the single most common misconfiguration, and npm run doctor reports it as a mismatch.

routing_bulkread_enforce.title: Bulk-read gate
routing_bulkread_enforce.description: What happens when a large read is delegated. deny hands Claude the worker's answer instead of the file; ask prompts; suggest only advises; off disables the gate. Every setting still fails open if the worker is unavailable.

hooks_taskintent_source.title: Task intent
hooks_taskintent_source.description: none sends the worker a fixed generic task, so nothing from your session leaves the machine. transcript lets the hook recover your newest prompt and ask the worker that instead: a better question, and one that sends your prompt text to the worker model. Redacted and length-clamped either way.

telemetry_enabled.title: Record telemetry
telemetry_enabled.description: Write one local JSONL row per delegation so npm run analytics and the HTML report have something to read. Nothing is ever sent anywhere; paths are hashed by default.
